answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 11775 Country: India Title: During fasting kissing by puting toung in mouth of 1.Non fasting wife will brake fast or no? 2.If wife also fasting then fast will brake or not? Question: During fasting kissing by puting toung in mouth of 1.Non fasting wife will brake fast or no? 2.If wife also fasting then fast will brake or not? Answer ID: 11775 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 561/561=M/1430) One should avoid licking the tongue of wife in the state of fasting; since swallowing the saliva of one?s beloved will break the fast and kaffarah (expiation) will be wajib if it is Ramadhan fasting; therefore one should avoid it. If wife is not fasting, then it is not undesirable in her case, but if husband is fasting he should avoid it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
